newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland, Russia to sign 25-year gas deal next week.
newsitem.headline: Poland, Russia to sign 25-year gas deal next week.

text.p: Poland will sign a 25-year contract for the delivery of Russian natural gas on September 25, the industry ministry said on Wednesday.
"On September 25 Poland and Russia will sign a 25-year gas agreement and details will be made available at that time," ministry spokeswoman Beata Nawracka told Reuters.
Poland's Oil and Gas company and Russia's Gazprom are expected to sign the deal.

Rzeczpospolita daily said on Wednesday that the deal would guarantee Gazprom that Poland would receive about 14 billion cubic metres of gas in 2010 via the Yamal pipeline, which will pump gas from the Siberian peninsula to Western Europe.
Polish gas consumption of 10.3 billion cubic metres last year is forecast to grow to 22-27 billion in the year 2010.
The planned agreement has its Polish critics, who say that such an agreement would once again make Poland dependent on Russian resources.
Poland earlier said it was also seeking to diversify its gas imports and planned to renew talks with Norwegian firms.
